newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:
Vessels: no data avilable due to a change in computer software at the port.
Road: 1,327 trucks carrying soybeans arrived between Aug 1 and 3, as well as 650 trucks with soymeal and 160 trucks with vegetable oils, including soyoil.

Vessels: No vessels docked at public terminal. Waiting to dock, two vessels to load soybeans. At Cargill private terminal, Lika loading 60,000 tonnes soymeal. No vessels waiting to dock. Road: 34 trucks carrying 827 tonnes soybeans arrived on Aug 3 as well as two trucks with 54 tonnes soymeal.
Rail: 11 wagons arrived with 466 tonnes soymeal.
